name: module06-project
description: MongoDB-based database system for SunshineMedicalCenter. This project demonstrates indexing strategies, schema design patterns, and advanced aggregation pipelines.

scripts.dc:logs: docker compose logs -f --tail=100 mongodb app mongo-express
scripts.dc:seed: docker compose exec app npm run --prefix starter-code seed
scripts.dc:start: docker compose exec app npm run --prefix starter-code start
scripts.dc:dev: docker compose exec app npm run --prefix starter-code dev
scripts.dc:npm: docker compose exec app npm --prefix starter-code
scripts.dc:test: docker compose exec app npm --prefix starter-code test
